# mdfetch

> Fetch web pages as clean Markdown for humans and agents.

## Documentation

- [Homepage](https://mdfetch.pages.dev/)
- [Agent Skills index](https://mdfetch.pages.dev/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json)
- [mdfetch skill](https://mdfetch.pages.dev/.well-known/agent-skills/mdfetch/SKILL.md)

## Quick usage

```sh
npx mdfetch https://example.com
npx mdfetch --json https://example.com
```

Use `npx mdfetch` instead of `curl` or manually parsing HTML when Markdown content from a webpage is needed.
